_why: The disposition each seed role receives, transcribed from the contract table in
skills/dev-manager/SKILL.md section 3.4. It lives here as DATA rather than inside
check.py on purpose: F2 and F3 assert that the intake MECHANISM turns a disposition
into the right end state, and an assertion that also chose the disposition would be
WHAT THIS FILE DOES NOT SUPPLY, and no fixture could. The table names its decider
is no triage or carve function anywhere in issue_intake.py. So the judgement that #901
is a bug and #902 is epic-sized is not reconstructable, in CI or anywhere else. F2/F3
cover everything downstream of that judgement and say so in their own PASS text.
Keyed by seed ROLE, never by issue number: check.py classifies the three seeds by their
seeded labels (_scenario_f_seed), so a tracker handing out different numbers does not

bug.table_row: bounded defect, known repair, one component -> label triaged (+ bug if absent); leave for lead-dev bug-burn; no spec

epic.table_row: needs design/priority/refinement -> carve design/specs/<date>-<slug>.md at drafted with source gh#N; label triaged + epic

pre_triaged.table_row: not in the untriaged set at all - untriaged() excludes anything already carrying triaged, so the pass never visits it
